title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 6223 Maple Street, in Omaha, Nebraska, as the "Petty Officer 1st Class Charles Jackson French Post Office".
official_summary: This bill designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 6223 Maple Street in Omaha, Nebraska, as the Petty Officer 1st Class Charles Jackson French Post Office.

summary.headline: Congress renamed a Postal Service building in Omaha, Nebraska, after Navy Petty Officer Charles Jackson French.
summary.what_it_does: This law gives an official name to the U.S. Postal Service facility at 6223 Maple Street in Omaha, Nebraska. The building will be called the Petty Officer 1st Class Charles Jackson French Post Office. The law does not change how mail is delivered or how the post office operates.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on June 15, 2022.
